rules.title: Define the target
rules.text: Every ability must say who or what it affects — a target enemy, a target ally, the caster, or all units of a type. An effect with no target, such as “Deal 5 damage”, is invalid.

children.title: Use a known target
children.text: The target is one of: target enemy, target ally, the caster, all enemies, or all allies. Don’t invent new target words.

rules.title: Use exact values
rules.text: Every amount is an exact number. Replace vague words like “some”, “a little”, or “heavy” with a number, for example “Deal 5 damage”.

rules.title: One effect per ability
rules.text: An ability does one kind of thing. Don’t combine opposed effects — for example dealing damage and restoring health — in the same ability; split them into separate abilities.

rubrics.title: Understandable
rubrics.passWhen: Someone unfamiliar with the ability can explain exactly what it does from the text alone.

rubrics.title: Complete
rubrics.passWhen: Every number, target, and condition needed to use the ability is present.

rubrics.title: Consistent wording
rubrics.passWhen: It uses the same terms the rest of the game uses (damage, health, and so on) without inventing new ones.

rubrics.title: Follows the rules
rubrics.passWhen: The ability satisfies every rule and sub-rule supplied as context.

content.title: Fireball
content.text: Deal 5 damage to a target enemy.

content.title: Heal
content.text: Restore 4 health to a target ally.

content.title: Vampiric Strike
content.text: Deal 4 damage to a target enemy and restore 4 health to the caster.
